scope: Pinned inputs for the bounded publication bundle: all published analytical case results and one optional real eBPF example. No full-study raw backup.

repository_tree.measurement: Parent's git blob inventory at specified head

optional_real_example.reason: Smallest absent-mode eBPF training+model package pair with nonnull graph hashes and available forecasts in the saved results.
optional_real_example.availability: Training and model verified live via run42347357851 artifacts API; not found by ID in the two partial full-input archive release asset lists. Use exact Actions IDs unless an independently verified permanent source is resolved.

limitations: Core contains per-case/per-operation analytical outputs, not all original108 raw input closure.
Only chosen source-model pair may be reconstructed; scientific artifact processing must run in repository Actions.
Original target_latency contains aggregate count/min/p50/p90/max/mean, no per-request latency array.
Original literal-results and corrected prospective summary omit class_test_assignments and target_descriptive_assignments; per-attempt classification reconstruction is outside the core.
Full original evaluation arrays remain in original metadata ZIPs; corrected full classes are in raw capture classes-v5.json. Those inputs are deliberately not selected for the core.
Input package bytes are compressed sizes recorded by GitHub; source tree size is before compression, so final archive size is not yet measured.
